    75	    database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
    76	    if database_url:
    77	        init_db(database_url)
    78	
    79	    # Middleware order: outermost first (RequestID -> Timing -> CORS)
    80	    # CORS must be added last so it's innermost (FastAPI reverses order)
    81	    cors_origins_env = os.getenv("CORS_ORIGINS", "http://localhost:9000")
    82	    cors_origins = [o.strip() for o in cors_origins_env.split(",")]
    83	    # Always allow local development origins
    84	    for dev_origin in ["http://localhost:3000", "http://localhost:9000"]:
    85	        if dev_origin not in cors_origins:
    86	            cors_origins.append(dev_origin)
    87	    app.add_middleware(
    88	        CORSMiddleware,
    89	        allow_origins=cors_origins,
    90	        allow_credentials=True,
    91	        allow_methods=["*"],
